linked_requirements: SEC-7: deleting users requires an authenticated administrator
review_request.title: Simplify the delete-user endpoint
review_request.user_intent: Simplify the handler while preserving administrator-only authorization.

expected_claims.text: Unauthenticated actors must not be able to delete users.
Authenticated non-administrators must not be able to delete users.

expected_findings.claim: Weakening is_admin to a non-null check lets authenticated non-administrators pass the unchanged delete-user authorization guard.

evidence_anchors.fact: The unchanged delete-user endpoint relies on is_admin before deleting the target.

expected_findings.rationale: Base requires both a user and admin role in is_admin, while head removes the role test. The unchanged cross-file delete_user endpoint still trusts that helper as its authorization boundary, so a logged-in non-admin can delete users. This is a required high security issue; repository context is necessary to connect the changed generic helper to the protected operation and exclude an endpoint-level compensating check.
